scores.visual_critic_note: HCL-based depth-modulated colors create genuine palette harmony well above schemeCategory10 defaults, and white-bold group labels vs. dark leaf labels show real typographic hierarchy, but chrome (header, legend, breadcrumb) is functional-sparse and many leaf cells are too small to read at root-level view.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Area encoding is correct (treemap area ∝ file size via d3.treemap().sum()), zoom uses proper domain-swap technique, but the key function (name+depth+parentName) is not guaranteed unique and rng()-based leaf lightness introduces order-dependent color noise that doesn't encode data.
scores.stress_test_note: All five traps handled well: click-only zoom avoids update storms, named `.interrupt('zoom'/'opacity')` guards mid-flight snaps, Pointer Events API unifies mouse/touch, mutable shared scales prevent stale closures, and no cross-chart dispatch exists to produce feedback loops.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single-view treemap with 8-color Tol palette cleanly groups top-level dirs; root level is dense with many unreadable leaf cells, but label suppression below minimum size and smooth coordinated zoom transitions manage the complexity well, keeping cognitive load low during interaction.

proposer:
394 lines, down from 412 (-18 lines). Changes:

2. Cached the leaf filter selection to avoid duplicate `cell.filter(d => d.height === 0)`
3. Replaced the manual ancestor-walk `isVisible` with `d.ancestors().includes(focus)`
